name: Aurora Reed Ensemble
description: Tall glowing reeds in a frozen marsh, each stem a different auroral color, swaying in a wind that carries no sound but paints the air with electromagnetic music.
prompt: Frozen marsh at night, tall reeds glowing with aurora colors — emerald, crimson, violet, gold — each stem a different hue, swaying in silent electromagnetic wind painting air with visible music frequencies, northern lights overhead mirroring reeds, ice crystals on frozen water, long exposure light trails, 8k, astrophotography style
